predecessor: EG-SCENARIO-SNAPSHOT-1 actual1 with exact audited release and separate feature and label seals
calendar: fixed original 257 sessions, first 100 excluded from evaluation, five existing expanding splits with their original cutoff and all 157 evaluation sessions retained
fit_information: same common causal support and mature primary gross for all three learners within a branch timing fold; label prefix strictly before first test day; forecast evaluation rows from feature stream only

training_support.one_class_target_first: unsupported probability output, retain observed class counts
training_support.unknown_primary: excluded from fit, retained in evaluation support and outcomes
training_support.hold_target: incremental fixed-cap versus next open in original-entry notional units; only common causal updates with mature labels

tcn.backend: CPU FP32 deterministic Torch 2.7.0+cu128 with hidden CUDA devices
tcn.optimizer: fixed AdamW with CPU state and gradient norm cap 1
tcn.loss: mean of available task means with MSE for returns and BCE logits for target-first

lgb.features: fixed masked chart summaries at 5/15/30/60, same four state features and one-hot task tag
lgb.loss: one numeric regression fit per coordinate; target-first trained as 0/1 and clipped to [0,1] at prediction, raw score and clip retained

entry.comparator: rule selects all common supported confirmations and retains known execution refusals
entry.learned: strict expected gross30 above fee in percentage points, equality or unsupported does not select, numerical threshold ambiguity reported separately
entry.cost_stress: report same 33bp selection at 43bp and also report the 43bp policy separately
entry.probability: fixed reliability bins, Brier and training prevalence on the same known pairs; diagnostic only

evaluation.returns: known gross and net per event with unresolved/missing entries or exits kept separate
evaluation.common_scope: same branch, timing, evaluation calendar and predecision common support; chart-only results separate
evaluation.frequency: all original evaluation weeks, count modeled entries separately from known exits, report >=15 and overlapping same-symbol intervals
evaluation.uncertainty: day-cluster estimate, known-day support, whole-calendar week and symbol concentration
evaluation.immediate_control: separate prospective first-high comparator; matched immediate/confirmation attribution may use only both-known events and is not an earlier policy filter

candidate_screen: Exploratory cost-robust candidate requires positive net43 and a positive lower day-cluster interval on both timing assumptions in the same arm and branch. Fewer than 10 contributing days or unavailable intervals remain exploratory. Report frequency and concentration separately; overlapping timing assumptions do not supply independent replication.
execution_gate: each actual fit unit is independently released and qualifies at original scale with exact source and local package pins before any market label decoding in that unit
